project_info.theme: Shopee birthday megalive with beauty-device giveaway
project_info.color_palette: Blush Pink, White, Rose Pink, Soft Gold, Beige

main_subject.detail: A glossy Shopee livestream birthday poster showing two celebrity hosts on the left and a lineup of Halio beauty devices on the right, promoting a minigame opportunity worth up to 40 million.
main_subject.style: K-pop-inspired livestream promo poster, glossy e-commerce event design, romantic pink sale aesthetic

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'Shopee LIVE', 'Sinh Nhật Hoành Tráng', 'Xả Láng Deal Ngon', 'MEGALIVE SHOPEE 10H | 03.04', 'kênh lucienguyenlove', 'LIXIBOX', and 'Cơ Hội Tham Gia MINIGAME Lên Đến 40 Triệu'.
items: Top Left: Shopee LIVE badge and the large pink birthday headline stack.
Top Right: LIXIBOX logo and a cluster of Halio products including facial device, razor-style tool, gold rectangular device, and mask-like lattice face tool over a heart shape.
Bottom Left: Seated male celebrity in a brown suit and standing female celebrity in a pale dress with one hand resting on his shoulder.
Bottom Right: Gift-box icons and a magenta CTA cluster reading 'Cơ Hội Tham Gia MINIGAME Lên Đến 40 Triệu'.
Center/Background: Soft pink glowing background with white sparkles and a translucent heart motif.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft glam highlights, dreamy sparkles, polished celebrity retouching, premium livestream energy

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity e-commerce event poster design

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a Shopee birthday megalive beauty-device event. Centerpiece is a pair of celebrity hosts on the left and a product cluster of Halio devices on the right. Background is a glossy blush-pink livestream setting with sparkles and a soft heart motif. Surrounding elements: 'Shopee LIVE', headline 'Sinh Nhật Hoành Tráng', subline 'Xả Láng Deal Ngon', badge 'MEGALIVE SHOPEE 10H | 03.04', channel text 'kênh lucienguyenlove', LIXIBOX logo, and CTA 'Cơ Hội Tham Gia MINIGAME Lên Đến 40 Triệu'. Keep the celebrity positions, product assortment, and romantic pink event mood. Technical style: high fidelity e-commerce event poster design, glossy studio poster lighting, soft glam highlights and dreamy sparkles, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed face, extra limbs, watermark, signature, cropped
